title: dactylis littoralis
intro: Dactylis littoralis, commonly known as coastal grass or sea grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases like heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis littoralis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, relieve stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
